market_signal.origin_note: market signal is authored in part E

sections.heading: C2 — Confusables and KG hints
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Stopping and Following

FACT_ID: sec08-R01 | anchor: A01
Stops chain half-second perception, two-thirds-second reaction, and speed-driven braking atop reaction, weather, weight, and brake health [A01].
Why it matters: group stop-chain; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec08-R02 | anchor: A01
Fixed-point counts fail under four seconds, and slick, bulky, two-wheeled, dark, and foul-weather follows all stretch wider [A01].
Why it matters: group counting; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec08-R03 | anchor: A02
Even pressure stops smoothly, and stick shifts slow only after brake-light warnings [A02].
Why it matters: group braking-basics; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F03 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec08-R04 | anchor: A02
Blowouts coast with gentle brakes, shoulder drops re-enter checked and slow, loose cover takes second-apart taps, and antilock pedals never tap [A02].
Why it matters: group brake-emergencies; difficulty high; prereq sec08-F03; confusables sec08-F04 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec08-R05 | anchor: A02
Standard brakes peak pre-lock while antilock methods live in the owner manual [A02].
Why it matters: group standard-vs-abs; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec08-R06 | anchor: A02
Skids want prevention, gentle traction tests, black-ice suspicion, and foot-off steering into slides except toward worse harm [A02].
Why it matters: group skid; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec08-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec08-R07 | anchor: A03
First rain slicks grease, standing wet floats tires, and cross-flow water stays forever unentered [A03].
Why it matters: group rain; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F07 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec08-R08 | anchor: A03
Gaps measure a car length per ten or three counted seconds rising to four, packs break apart, and caravans split two hundred feet [A03].
Why it matters: group gaps; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F08 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec08-R09 | anchor: A03
Trucks stop longer by bulk yet can grip harder fast or wet, so tailgaters court their bumpers [A03].
Why it matters: group trucks; difficulty low; prereq sec08-F08; confusables sec08-F09 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec08-R10 | anchor: A04
Rear-enders lose to deep brake-light watches, gap alarms, fixed-object checks, and cushioned anticipation [A04].
Why it matters: group rear-end; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F10 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec08-R11 | anchor: A04
Tailgaters meet flashes, then slowing, then a locked-door peopled pull-over [A04].
Why it matters: group tailgater; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F11 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0045]
